This application uses heic-to 1.5.2 to decode HEIC/HEIF photos locally.
The library is used without modifications, under LGPL-3.0-or-later.
It includes libheif and libde265, also distributed under LGPL terms.

Library and corresponding source:
https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to
https://www.npmjs.com/package/heic-to/v/1.5.2
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
https://github.com/strukturag/libde265

License texts accompany this notice: heic-to-LICENSE.txt and GPL-3.0.txt.
